summary.headline: Infinity Infoway reported Q1 FY27 revenue of Rs. 689 lakhs, EBITDA Rs. 344 lakhs and PAT Rs. 201 lakhs, with ZeroTouch launched and Rs. 75 crore order book cited.
summary.overview:
Management said Q1 FY27 revenue was Rs. 689 lakhs, with EBITDA of Rs. 344 lakhs and PAT of Rs. 201 lakhs, which it described as roughly 100%+ revenue growth, about 115% EBITDA growth and 93% PAT growth versus the year-ago quarter. The company launched its patented ZeroTouch secure question-paper machine in Jaipur on 16 May 2026 and delivered an Rs. 11 crore AI solution order for higher education. Sales and marketing headcount was expanded across multiple states, which drove higher employee cost. Management also flagged a strategic acquisition push across technology, education, FinTech, AI and data centre. The call was Q&A-heavy with individual investors, and several figures were corrected or restated during the call.</overview>

segments.name: Education ERP (incl. online examination)
segments.commentary: Management said education ERP is about 60% of revenue; online examination is described as a sub-line within education. Q1 revenue was down about 25% QoQ, which management attributed to seasonality and business process factors.

segments.name: Manufacturing ERP
segments.commentary: About 40% of revenue per management. AI use case for finance, sales, production and inventory was highlighted in the business presentation.

segments.name: ZeroTouch (patented DaaS question-paper device)
segments.commentary: Launched 16 May 2026 in Jaipur; 150 machines developed to date, with pilot orders only and tenders bid. Management guided Rs. 5-6 crore of ZeroTouch orders in FY27 and ZeroTouch revenue of 20-22% of total within about two years; EBITDA margin expected at 55-60%.

guidance_outlook: ZeroTouch expected to contribute 20-22% of revenue within about two years (management's stated timeline, 'maximum two years').
Minimum Rs. 5-6 crore ZeroTouch order expected in FY27.
AI/LLM product targeted for launch to existing customers in Q3 FY27 (by 31 March 2027 for revenue start); initial pricing per user with free query quota and paid top-ups.
Long-term EBITDA margin focus stated at 42-46%, with preference for higher-margin products.
Two further products under development, to be launched 'very soon' (Vision 29 plan); strategic acquisitions being evaluated across five areas.
capex_capacity: 150 ZeroTouch machines developed to date; none currently under development per management, with ongoing accuracy improvements and deployment.
Intangible asset base of Rs. 10 crore; management expects a further 10-20% addition from the two products under development, with 15-20% further addition for LLM training and go-live.
Management declined to give a peak intangible figure, saying investment depends on cash flow and expected revenue impact.
Sales and marketing team expanded to Chandigarh, Odisha, Bihar (Patna), Jaipur, Pune, Mumbai, Indore, Bhopal, Rajkot; ongoing employee cost increase expected to continue.
demand_pricing: ZeroTouch revenue model is device-as-a-service, billed per question paper printed and delivered at classroom; machines are not sold.
ZeroTouch focus is 100% government for now (competitive and university exams with mass, high-risk papers); confirmed orders still pending, only pilot orders in hand.
Higher-education AI order of Rs. 11 crore received in the prior quarter; delivery started in Q1 FY27.
Admission portal in Madhya Pradesh cited as record: 117 million views and 2.8 million unique users.
AI add-on pricing planned per user and per query, with a free initial query quota.

qa_highlights.question: What is the expected timeline for ZeroTouch to reach 20-22% of revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the target is planned within about two years, with FY27 a good year and FY28 greater.

qa_highlights.question: How many ZeroTouch machines are developed and under development?
qa_highlights.answer: 150 machines developed to date; no further machines under development currently, with focus on deployment and accuracy improvements.

qa_highlights.question: What is the ZeroTouch revenue model and EBITDA margin?
qa_highlights.answer: Device-as-a-service billed per question paper delivered; EBITDA margin expected at 55-60%, versus ERP business.

qa_highlights.question: What is the ERP order book and ZeroTouch pipeline?
qa_highlights.answer: ERP order book Rs. 75 crore as of 30 May 2026 (also cited as a two-year order book including ARAM long-term government contract); ZeroTouch Rs. 5-6 crore expected in FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Is the employee cost increase one-time?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the increase from expanded sales and marketing teams will continue, with further expansion possible if needed.

qa_highlights.question: What are the intangible asset levels and expected additions?
qa_highlights.answer: Rs. 10 crore on books; 10-20% further addition expected from products in development; no peak number given.

risks_watch: ZeroTouch revenue depends on converting pilot orders into confirmed government/university orders; none confirmed yet on the call.
Rising intangible assets (Rs. 10 crore base) and capitalised AI development could pressure future profitability if revenue timing slips.

Figure inconsistencies on the call: the ERP order book was cited as Rs. 75 crore 'till 30 May' and also as a two-year order book; Q1 QoQ decline was first stated as 30% and then corrected to 25%. Verify against filings.
Management said an AI/LLM product revenue start is targeted by 31 March 2027; watch for launch timing.
Strategic acquisition plans across five focus areas with no target or size disclosed.
Stated EBITDA margin of 55-60% for ZeroTouch and the 42-46% company range are management claims without disclosed base data.
summary.management_tone: Confident and promotional on product milestones and growth, with ZeroTouch and AI presented as major opportunities. Answers were vague or revised on several numeric questions (order book timing, QoQ decline, intangible peak), and management declined to give a peak intangible figure.
key_quotes: So, we have recorded the revenues in Quarter 1 of Rs. 689 lakhs with the EBITDA of Rs. 344 lakhs and PAT margin, sorry PAT after tax, profit after tax is Rs. 201 lakhs.
So, our revenue model is based on the number of question paper getting print and delivered at the classroom.

So, as of now, we have a pilot order confirmed. The upcoming, as per your questions, on this year, we are expecting to have a minimum Rs. 5 crores to Rs. 6 crores order on ZeroTouch in this year only.
